input.content:
# Quarterly operations report — May–July 2026

## Summary

The quarter was solidly profitable, with revenue of €1,233,225 against costs of
€467,640 for a net of €765,585 and a 62.1% margin. Underneath the headline,
however, the quarter decelerated: revenue grew 4.6% in June but fell 9.6% in
July, ending the quarter below where it started. Customer momentum weakened in
parallel — new signings declined each month (86, 74, 63) while churn rose
(17, 22, 31), so net adds fell from 69 in May to 32 in July. Support kept pace
throughout, closing 95.5% of the 1,001 tickets opened over the quarter.

## Key figures

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Quarterly revenue | €1,233,225 |
| Quarterly costs | €467,640 |
| Net | €765,585 |
| Margin | 62.1% |
| Net customer adds | 153 |
| Ticket close rate | 95.5% |
| June revenue growth | 4.6% |
| July revenue growth | -9.6% |

## Notes

Worth flagging upward:

- **June cost discrepancy.** June's cost line items sum to €158,540, €300 more
  than the stated total of €158,240. The stated totals were used here; finance
  should reconcile.
- **July revenue decline.** July's 9.6% drop coincided with a marketing spend
  cut (€16,980 vs €21,400 in June) and the quarter's weakest signings — worth
  checking whether that's causal.
- **Churn trend.** Churn nearly doubled over the quarter (17 → 31/month) and is
  the main drag on net adds; it predates the July revenue dip, so it may signal
  a product or support issue rather than a spending one.
